bibl.title: Śāhajivilāsagītā
Śāhavilāsagīta
bibl.note: Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952.

Modelled on the Gītagovinda: just as there are three main characters in the Gītagovinda - Krishna, Radhā and her maid - in this work the three characters are king Śahaji I, the courtesan Līlavatī and her maid. Consists of eight sargas and 24 aṣṭapadis.

This work earned the author the title 'Abhinava Jayadeva'. See Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952: p. 55.
